run_extract_train_features: extract RMAC region features from all dataset images using a pretrained VGG-16 model
run_train_pca: train a PCA whitening model on extracted feature vectors and save to pickle
run_extract_db_features: extract RMAC descriptors with PCA whitening for all database images in the dataset
run_extract_query_features: extract RMAC descriptors with ROI cropping for all query images in the dataset
run_eval_retrieval: evaluate image retrieval performance by computing similarity scores and mAP on Oxford or Paris
